question: Malwa Plateau is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malwa Plateau** is primarily located in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The plateau is bounded by the **Aravalli Range** to the northwest, the **Vindhya Range** to the south, and the **Bundelkhand** region to the east.
 
• It is known for its rich history and was a significant part of the ancient Avanti Mahajanapada.
 
• The region is also notable for its black cotton soil, known as **Regur**, which is highly suitable for cotton cultivation.
 
• Malwa Plateau is rich in mineral resources and has significant deposits of **coal and limestone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The region plays a crucial role in India's **agriculture and economy**, contributing significantly to the production of crops like wheat, soybeans, and pulses.
 
• **Indore**, the largest city in Madhya Pradesh, is located on the southern edge of the Malwa Plateau and serves as a major commercial and educational hub.
 
• The **historical city of Ujjain**, located on the eastern side of the plateau, is one of the seven sacred cities (Sapta Puri) in Hinduism and hosts the famous **Kumbh Mela** every 12 years.
 
• Malwa Plateau has a rich cultural heritage with numerous **forts, palaces, and temples** that attract tourists from all over the world.
 
• The region has also contributed significantly to Indian classical music, particularly the **Malwa School of Dhrupad**.
